name: Seed Vault Aurora
description: The Svalbard Global Seed Vault reimagined as a living aurora — each seed variety a distinct color particle in the northern lights, the vault's entrance a doorway into the dancing genome of Earth's future.
prompt: Svalbard Global Seed Vault entrance glowing at Arctic twilight, but the aurora borealis above is composed of distinct colored particles — each hue a different seed variety: wheat gold, rice pearl, maize amber, tomato crimson, heritage rainbow — particles dance in genetic sequences, vault door opens into light tunnel of dancing genomes, polar bears watch from distance, facility lights warm against blue ice, hopeful futuristic vision, 8k, cinematic Arctic photography style
caption:
